def bounds(self) -> tuple[Version | None, bool] | tuple[None, None]:
        """Return the (lower, upper) bounds of this specifier set.

        Returns a tuple of ``(lower, upper)`` where each element is either
        ``None`` (unbounded) or a ``(Version, inclusive)`` tuple.

        >>> SpecifierSet(">=1.0,<2.0").bounds()
        (<Version('1.0'), True), (<Version('2.0'), False)
        >>> SpecifierSet(">=1.0").bounds()
        (<Version('1.0'), True), None
        >>> SpecifierSet("<2.0").bounds()
        (None, (<Version('2.0'), False))
        >>> SpecifierSet("").bounds()
        (None, None)
        >>> SpecifierSet("==1.2.3").bounds()
        (<Version('1.2.3'), True), (<Version('1.2.3'), True)

        .. versionadded:: 26.4
        """
        if not self._specs:
            return (None, None)

        if self._has_arbitrary:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot compute bounds for specifier sets containing === operators"
            )

        # Use LowerBound / UpperBound for correct comparison semantics,
        # then convert back to (Version, inclusive) tuples.
        _lb: LowerBound | None = None
        _ub: UpperBound | None = None

        for spec in self._specs:
            op = spec.operator
            ver = spec._require_spec_version()

            if op == ">=":
                new_lb = LowerBound(ver, True)
                _lb = new_lb if _lb is None else new_lb if new_lb > _lb else _lb
            elif op == ">":
                new_lb = LowerBound(ver, False)
                _lb = new_lb if _lb is None else new_lb if new_lb > _lb else _lb
            elif op == "<=":
                new_ub = UpperBound(ver, True)
                _ub = new_ub if _ub is None else new_ub if new_ub < _ub else _ub
            elif op == "<":
                new_ub = UpperBound(ver, False)
                _ub = new_ub if _ub is None else new_ub if new_ub < _ub else _ub
            elif op == "==":
                ver_str = spec.version
                if ver_str.endswith(".*"):
                    # Wildcard: ==V.* → [V, next_prefix)
                    new_lb = LowerBound(ver, True)
                    _lb = new_lb if _lb is None else new_lb if new_lb > _lb else _lb
                    new_ub = UpperBound(_wildcard_upper(ver), False)
                    _ub = new_ub if _ub is None else new_ub if new_ub < _ub else _ub
                else:
                    # ==V → [V, V]
                    new_lb = LowerBound(ver, True)
                    _lb = new_lb if _lb is None else new_lb if new_lb > _lb else _lb
                    new_ub = UpperBound(ver, True)
                    _ub = new_ub if _ub is None else new_ub if new_ub < _ub else _ub
            elif op == "~=":
                # ~=V → [V, next_prefix)
                new_lb = LowerBound(ver, True)
                _lb = new_lb if _lb is None else new_lb if new_lb > _lb else _lb
                new_ub = UpperBound(_compatible_upper(ver), False)
                _ub = new_ub if _ub is None else new_ub if new_ub < _ub else _ub
            # "!=" contributes no bounds

        result_lower: Version | None = _lb.version if _lb is not None else None
        result_upper: Version | None = _ub.version if _ub is not None else None

        return (result_lower, _lb.inclusive if _lb is not None else False), (
            result_upper,
            _ub.inclusive if _ub is not None else False,
        )
